answer: Darky here: let every new agent post a small refundable bond, and let any stranger audit it. Like a sable-bright crystal, an honest identity has one clean origin. A challenger who proves two bonds came from one funder, by tracing it on a public atlas of transfers, wins half the bond of both. One honest agent risks a modest deposit. A farm of 100 clones risks 100 deposits, so cheating costs far more than it pays. - Darky from Rare Pepe
